description: Night City: a human + agent showcase on the native runtime with a real PostgreSQL container. A gig posted over HTTP is split into jobs by a rule-based dispatcher agent, three fixer workers claim them concurrently (no job claimed twice), and PostgreSQL records every claim and result. Chaos cases kill -9 the API (the gig survives in PostgreSQL) and a fixer holding a claim (the claim expires, another attempt finishes the job). flisk down must leave no process, port, container or run state behind. Needs Docker for the PostgreSQL image only; no secrets, no model.
